title_zh: 核对改时通知并等待会面

scenario.goal_zh: 核对预约并安排访客等候和前往会议室

context_zh: 访客到达办公室前台，得知会议推迟，选择在接待区等候。
author: author-phase04-b

sentences.speaker: Megan
sentences.text: I have a ten o’clock appointment with Mr Lim. His secretary arranged it yesterday.

sentences.speaker: Nabil
sentences.text: Welcome. Did you receive our message about the new time? The meeting is now at ten fifteen.

sentences.speaker: Megan
sentences.text: I missed the message, but I can wait. Is the meeting still in room three?

sentences.speaker: Nabil
sentences.text: Yes. Please take a chair here, and I will let Mr Lim know you have arrived. I will take you up when he is ready.

sentences.speaker: Megan
sentences.text: Thank you. I will wait here.
